text.tspan: Not by works I stand, but by grace alone,
In His mercy shown, love to me made known.
Found in Christ my King, in His truth I ’bide;
All the world may claim treasures bright and bold,
But in Christ alone, I have wealth untold.
Not by past or pride, nor by things I’ve done,
But by faith in Him, the victory’s won.
Pressing on I go, leaving self behind,
With my eyes on Him, true life now I find.
All my worth and gain don’t deserve my care;
Nothing with the love of Christ compares.
